t: The Sun Company Amusement Resort Advertised Naked Women To Appear In A Dance Called "The Attack On A Beautiful Woman By A Savage"

pages.en:
FM.
G. 3000-1

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
S. 3, Special Branch
REPORT
Date March 23, 1938.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE File No. REGIST... No. S. B. D. 7042 ... - J）

Subject The Sun Company Amusement Resort advertised naked women to appear in
a dance called "The Attack On A Beautiful Woman By A Savage".

Made by ... and ... Forwarded by D.S.I. MacAdie.

The following is a translation of an advertisement
which appears in the Sin Wan Pao edition of March 23 and which
was inserted by the Sun Company Amusement Resort (大新遊樂場)
in connection with the performance of a dance by the Chia-Loh-
Pao's Chorus and Dancing Group on the night of 23.3.38 :-

The "Chia-Loh-Pao's Chorus and Dancing Group"

"This chorus and dancing group consists of
"some 30 members and will to-day perform a dance
"called 'The Attack On A Beautiful Woman By A
"Savage' (野人劫艳记) in which bonfires, Red
"Indian savages and girls in the nude will
"appear. The story of this dance is very
"curious. The public are advised to see it."

Similar advertisements have appeared in the past and
have resulted in warnings being given to the theatre
proprietors and newspaper editors (vide attached file No.
D.7042).

Instructions are solicited as to what action should
be taken against the Resort Management and/or the Sin Wan Pao.

The objectionable advertisement was not submitted to
S. 3 for approval.

（左侧批注：FILE 682 24/3）

D. C. (Special Branch).
D.C. (Special Branch)
Sir
Instructions solicited
R.W. Mac Adie
D.S.I
23 3.

（印章：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE S.3. SPECIAL BRANCH * 23 MAR. 1938 *）

S3

R.W. Mac Adie
D. S. I.
xDB49-C39

Send someone to view
the show & report.
Take out M.A. summons
for Sin Wan Pao (ref x report of Feb 18)
Warn Sun Co to remove advt. if show actually not indecent.
If it is refer again.

发件人：
G. 3000-1

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
S. 3，特别科
报告
日期：1938年3月23日。

（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处 档案号 REGIST... 号 S. B. D. 7042 ... - J）

事由：大新游乐场刊登广告，宣称将有裸体女子出演名为“野人劫艳记”的舞蹈。

呈报人：……及…… 由副督察长 MacAdie 转呈。

以下为刊登于3月23日《新闻报》版面的广告译文，该广告由大新游乐场（大新遊樂場）插入，旨在宣传嘉乐宝歌舞团于1938年3月23日晚演出的舞蹈：

“嘉乐宝歌舞团”

“本歌舞团由约30名成员组成，今日将表演名为‘野人劫艳记’（野人劫艳记）的舞蹈，届时将出现篝火、红印第安野蛮人以及裸体少女。该舞蹈的故事颇为奇特。建议公众前往观看。”

此类广告过去曾出现过，并导致向剧院业主和报纸编辑发出警告（参见附件档案号 D.7042）。

现请示应对游乐场管理方和/或《新闻报》采取何种行动。

该不当广告未提交 S. 3 科审批。

（左侧批注：档案 682 24/3）

D. C. （特别科）。
D.C. （特别科）
长官
请示指令
R.W. Mac Adie
副督察长
23 3.

（印章：上海公共租界工部局警务处 S.3. 特别科 * 1938年3月23日 *）

S3

R.W. Mac Adie
副督察长
xDB49-C39

派人去观看
演出并提交报告。
对《新闻报》提起治安法庭传票诉讼（参考2月18日的报告 x）
如果演出实际上并不淫秽，则警告大新公司撤下广告。
如果确实淫秽，则再次上报。
